mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 77 degrees at Verona Area High School under clear skies. Expect an overnight low of 71 degrees with no rain. Also, the ISS will be visible for four minutes at 4:17 AM, traveling from the northwest to the east-northeast.

The Verona Senior Center is upgrading its flooring starting September 1. Please note that wellness appointments will continue, but the center will be closed for Labor Day on September 7, with a grand reopen house scheduled for September 10.

We have a packed week ahead! Enjoy Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can catch trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, or Paddy Mac's. Plus, don't miss the Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park this Tuesday.

In our weekly police report, on August 25, officers responded to a medical emergency where they successfully used an A E D to assist a resident, highlighting the vital equipment carried in all our patrol cars.
Today's flavor was Turtle Dove. Since we are closed for the evening, please join us tomorrow starting at 10:00 AM for the delicious Chocolate Heath Crunch.
